_comment_pitcherThrowsLeftHanded: Pitcher throws with the left hand when true; right hand when false.
_comment_dataset: Yoshinobu Yamamoto, 2025 MLB regular season. Speed and rpm are observed; axes and lift are fitted simulator parameters. Sources are listed below.
_comment_simulation: Root parameters duplicate FourSeam. Fitted axes/lift coefficients require useCoefficientTable=false; releaseHeightMeters is assumed.
_comment_randomPitchProfileEnabled: False selects FourSeam initially. Random mode selects profiles uniformly and does not reproduce real-world usage percentages.
